# House of Flora

> Contemporary Indian womenswear boutique in Janjgir, Chhattisgarh, India. Now open, offering sarees, suits, lehengas and fusion wear for celebrations and everyday wear.

House of Flora is a boutique clothing store selling contemporary Indian womenswear — expressive colour, considered detailing and wearable elegance for special occasions, celebrations, and everyday confidence. The store is physically located near Canal Bridge, opposite Shubh Labh Hotel, in Janjgir, Chhattisgarh, India, and is owned by Surbhi Bais.

## What they sell

- Sarees — for festive and formal occasions
- Suits / kurtis / co-ord sets — everyday and statement wear
- Lehengas — for weddings and celebrations
- Western / fusion wear — for women who move between tradition and everyday style

## Key facts

- Business type: Clothing boutique (women's contemporary Indian wear)
- Location: Near Canal Bridge, Opposite Shubh Labh Hotel, Janjgir, Chhattisgarh 495668, India
- Owner: Surbhi Bais
- Contact: +91 99933 01897 (call or WhatsApp)
- Instagram: @the.houseof.flora
- Hours: Open daily, 10:00–20:00 IST
- Ordering: Customers can message the boutique directly on WhatsApp to enquire about the collection or arrange a visit
